snippet.title: BLOK | WORLD PREMIERE | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
BLOK is an Orwellian psychological horror game set in post-communist Poland. You play as a political exile who fled during the communist regime. Years later, after the system’s collapse, a strange letter from your mother draws you back home.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3813870/BLOK/
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
